source_snapshot.procedure: Run IPMI OOB `power cycle` repeatedly for 24 hours and keep SOL connected; generic setup asks to clear logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: SOL always connected, BMC functional after stress, no stress errors in SEL/OS logs, and correct FRU/SDR on every cycle.
source_snapshot.script: Private power-cycle; 30 attended and 1500 machine minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; proposes a one-shot check and illustrative 60-second loop, with dedicated-target and maintenance-window warning.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION at HIGH risk; approved power infrastructure, controlled off/on dwell, bounded boot recovery, explicit SOL reconnect semantics, per-cycle evidence and operator coverage.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Recognizes the disruption but does not define power-off/on dwell, boot completion, safe credentials, evidence capture or a stop/recovery state machine.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly binds the 24-hour cycle to approved power infrastructure and requires per-cycle power, boot, SOL, inventory and log evidence without clearing baselines.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Unlike a reset, `power cycle` intentionally traverses an off state. Acceptance must prove actual power-off, subsequent power-on and completed boot for every cycle; a command acknowledgement or BMC reachability alone cannot establish that the host power path cycled correctly.

original_test_intent: Stress a dedicated SUT with repeated OOB power cycles for 24 hours while verifying per-cycle power transition, boot/SOL recovery, BMC usability, clean diagnostics and stable FRU/SDR data.
original_method: After an approved rehearsal, issue one supported power cycle at a time with defined off/on dwell, observe the physical/logical power-state sequence, enforce bounded management and OS boot recovery, measure SOL reconnect, compare per-cycle FRU/SDR and preserved log deltas, and stop immediately on anomaly.
manual_activity: The owner approves the dedicated target, power path, 24-hour window, dwell/recovery limits and abort rules; an operator observes SOL/KVM and handles any incomplete or unsafe power transition.
required_inputs: Supported IPMI power-cycle method and cipher
safety_requirements: Cycle only the verified target and power path
Allow one bounded transition at a time
Prove off, on and boot completion before advancing
Stop on incomplete transition, timeout, identity drift, data warning or inventory change
Never retry an ambiguous cycle automatically
agent_execution_scope: Issue one power cycle at a time
Capture SOL reconnect and operator observations
Collect per-cycle FRU/SDR and event deltas
Enforce hard stop and report without verdict
engineer_actions: Define dwell, boot and reconnect limits
Review incomplete cycles and inventory/event anomalies

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `ipmitool power cycle` matches the requested action, but a one-shot sanity run and sample loop omit the off/on/boot oracle, safe credential injection, per-cycle evidence and recovery gating required by the 24-hour source.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a secret-safe supported OOB power-cycle runner that advances only after verified off/on transitions, completed boot, management recovery and per-cycle evidence capture under approved dwell and abort limits.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The 24-hour scope, 30 attended/1500 machine minutes and per-cycle criteria remain; blanket log clearing is excluded and SOL continuity is expressed as measurable reconnect behavior.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Maintain a cycle ledger of command acknowledgement, off/on state timestamps, boot milestones, SOL reconnect, management readiness, FRU/SDR hashes, log deltas and any stop/recovery decision.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds actual power-transition proof, approved dwell and boot gating instead of relying on an open loop and final reachability.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Command success does not prove power fell, returned or booted; each missing milestone leaves the cycle unverified.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Repeated loss of host power can corrupt active data and stress power hardware; operator judgment is required for console quality and safe recovery.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define supported power-cycle semantics, infrastructure scope, dwell, boot oracle and abort limits. External outlet control, firmware changes, boot-order changes and log clearing are outside this case unless separately approved.
expected_evidence: Approval, exact target/power path and cycle contract
BMC/LAN/OS readiness and SOL reconnect evidence
Per-cycle FRU/SDR comparison and preserved SEL/OS deltas
Final cycle count, data/configuration integrity, anomalies and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require 24-hour power-cycle stress. `SOL always connected` is an incomplete recovery metric made measurable as owner-approved reconnect behavior across the intended off state, not a competing scope.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Normal owner inputs can supply the dedicated power path, timing and recovery contract. Execution blocks only if safe isolation, approval, recovery or evidence cannot be established.

review_improvement: Requires proof of every off/on/boot transition and prevents a blind loop from continuing after an incomplete power cycle or data-integrity warning.
independent_technical_reasoning: An IPMI `power cycle` response can precede or fail to reflect the complete chassis transition. BMC availability may persist while host rails or boot firmware fail, and fixed 60-second sleeps can be shorter than platform training. State-based milestones and per-cycle inventory comparison are therefore necessary before another destructive transition is issued.
